Home.hero_title: Handwoven magic, one stitch at a time
Home.hero_subtitle: At Mokka Crochet we bring your favorite characters to life and create endearing companions. Specialists in Pokémon amigurumis, children's movies, and custom designs made with love.
Home.story_p1: It all started with a needle, a ball of yarn, and the illusion of creating something unique. Mokka Crochet was born from the passion to transform threads into smiles. Every plushie we weave carries hours of dedication, care in details, and a design meant to captivate both children and adults.
Home.story_p2: We are not just a store; we are a workshop of dreams where your favorite characters from Pokémon, anime, or movies come to life in their softest and most huggable version. We believe in the value of craftsmanship, the magic of handmade things, and creating memories that will last a lifetime.
Home.newsletter_desc: Subscribe to receive news about new designs, patterns, and exclusive offers.

Blog.title: Mokka Crochet Blog
Blog.subtitle: Stories, tips, and the creative process behind our amigurumis
Blog.post1_title: Mokka Crochet's Journey: From Passion to Profession
Blog.post1_intro: It all started with a simple crochet hook and a ball of yarn...
Blog.post1_paragraph1: Three years ago, I discovered the world of crochet almost by chance. Looking for a relaxing activity after long work days, I found an amigurumi tutorial on YouTube and decided to give it a try. I never imagined that little Pikachu would be the beginning of an incredible journey.
Blog.post1_paragraph2: At first, the results were... interesting. My first attempts looked more like sci-fi creatures than amigurumis. But something captured me: the satisfaction of transforming simple yarn into something with life and personality.
Blog.post1_paragraph3: With each project, I improved. I started experimenting with different yarns, textures, and colors. Pokémon were my specialty at first - Pikachu, Charmander, Bulbasaur - each one a unique challenge to capture their essence in yarn.
Blog.post1_quote: Crochet isn't just about creating something beautiful, it's about the process, the patience, and the love you put into every stitch.
Blog.post1_paragraph4: I shared my creations on social media and the response was incredible. Friends, family, and strangers started asking for custom orders. What started as a hobby became a small but growing business.
Blog.post1_paragraph5: Today, Mokka Crochet is more than a business - it's my passion made reality. Every amigurumi I create carries a piece of my heart, and I hope it brings joy to whoever receives it.
Blog.post1_conclusion: Thank you for being part of this journey. There are many more stories to tell and many more amigurumis to create!
